title: Spec's Suggested Review Order line refs for form_stepper.js are r0 positions — 4 of 6 point at unrelated constructs in the shipped file
evidence: Spec lines read from the committed file: '[`form_stepper.js:221`](../../server/priv/static/form_stepper.js#L221)' (labelled 'Entry point: progressive-enhancement choreography'), '[`form_stepper.js:406`](...#L406)' ('Continue: preflight hold + analytics-truth input dispatch'), '[`form_stepper.js:185`](...#L185)' ('First-error start step'), '[`form_stepper.js:345`](...#L345)' ('markInvalid'). Actual shipped file: line 221 is '      el.querySelector &&' (inside focusTargetFor; initBrowser is at 284), line 406 is '        sections[i].el.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" });' (inside show(); onContinue is at 473), line 185 is '  // The Continue hold for the documents step (pure predicate, exported for' (firstErrorIndex is at 235), line 345 is '      seg.className = "stepper-segment";' (markInvalid is at 411).
detail: The review-order guide was written against the r0 file (commit 61fd895) and not updated after the r1 fixes (7ac11fe) grew form_stepper.js. Committed reviewer guidance now routes readers to the wrong functions.
recommended_fix: Update the four refs to the shipped positions (initBrowser ~284, onContinue ~473, firstErrorIndex ~235, markInvalid ~411) or drop line numbers and name the functions.

title: Minimal-DOM test harness copy-pasted across both js-test files and already diverging
evidence: form_stepper.test.js line 20: '// ---------- Minimal DOM (mirrors apply_analytics.test.js) ----------' with its own 'function el(tag, attrs = {}, children = []) {' (line 23) adding 'node.setAttribute = (k, v) => {' / 'node.getAttribute = (k) => (k in node ? node[k] : null);' and 'function fakeDoc(roots) {' (line 88). apply_analytics.test.js line 124: '// ---------- Minimal DOM for section rules ----------' with its own 'function el(tag, attrs = {}, children = []) {' (line 127) that has only querySelectorAll/contains and a narrower matches() (line 163).
detail: Two copies of the same stub DOM now exist with different capabilities (the stepper's el/matches/fakeDoc superset). AGENTS.md's DRY rule (extract at 2+ repeats) applies; every future js-test will fork a third copy. CommonJS require is already used, so sharing is trivial.
recommended_fix: Extract the harness into scripts/js-tests/dom_stub.js (CommonJS export) and require it from both test files; keep per-file selector extensions local.
